message: A pretty tough foe. Still, thanks to all that steady, rigorous training, we somehow managed to clinch the victory.

name: Ardin
message: 「What the hell?! You guys ain't ordinary humans... That power--don't tell me it's the power of an angel?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-N-No, you're wrong! I'm not an angel at a~~ll!\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, hold on a sec! What's the deal with Misa and Lolo-chan suddenly getting all cozy with Synn?! T-This is a major criiiisis!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, let's just drop this pointless fighting already.」

name: Ardin
message: 「Grrr! A handshake between two dudes?! Like hell I could do that! My love is eternally a dud!」
Ardin bolted away at the speed of a swordfish. No wonder marlin doesn't have much fat on it.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Do you think he meant to say 'undying'~?」
What on earth was that all about...
